title: THE PAIR SHARES ITS MARKS AND SETTINGS INSIDE ITCH
why: coord-06 on 2026-10-21: in itch frame player 1 and player 2 keep separate stores, so the raid marks and the shared sound and kid settings never crossed. Player 2 now sends a beat every 2 seconds and the settings are compared once a second over the window bridge, so player 1 never opens a window over a live player 2 raid and both windows keep the same sound and kid settings. Saves are not shared.
now: On itch, player 1 is told when player 2 is in a raid, and the shared sound and kid settings follow in both windows.
